prompt:
Warm editorial storybook illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette. Picture-book register for adults. NEVER comic, NEVER cartoon, NEVER flat vector, NEVER photoreal, NEVER neon, NEVER 3D or CGI or Pixar, NEVER glossy plastic. Use the first reference ONLY for the illustration STYLE. Use the second reference for the small glowing book's look: its pages, its glow, its tiny symbols.

An ISOLATED OBJECT STUDY. The whole frame is one plain flat warm cream field, empty and uniform edge to edge, holding only the object below and a soft shadow beneath it.

THE OBJECT, seen straight from the side. A short upright cream post stands at the left. Passing horizontally through the top of that post is ONE SINGLE UNBROKEN SHAFT that runs all the way to the right edge of the frame, level and straight.

That shaft is the SPINE OF AN OPEN BOOK. At the post, the book's covers and pages fan UPWARD and OUTWARD from the shaft like a butterfly opening, hinged along it, so the spine of the book and the long horizontal bar are visibly ONE CONTINUOUS PIECE of the same cream material, flowing into each other with no break, no seam, no joint, no collar, no ring, no circle, no wheel, no bracket, no bolt. The pages rise from the shaft; the shaft continues past them as the bar. Each visible page carries two or three tiny abstract symbols only: a small heart, a small open hand, a small balance-scale. The pages glow softly warm.

Resting on top of the bar toward the right: one single sheet of completely BLANK smooth cream paper, TILTED at a clear diagonal, its lower edge PRESSED DIRECTLY AGAINST the bar and supported by it, caught and held. The sheet is pristine, whole, uncreased, perfectly clean, unmarked on both sides, no lines and no writing.

Quiet, warm, calm, gentle. Nothing damaged. No padlock, no chain, no keyhole, no fence, no wall, no red. No people, no hands, no figures. No landscape, no horizon, no sky, no path. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words anywhere.

READABLE SURFACES FACE THEIR READER: any book, page, letter, scroll or sign a character is reading or writing faces THAT CHARACTER, never the camera. Compose over-the-shoulder or from behind so the surface genuinely faces them. Any handwriting is abstract handwriting-like line work with NO real readable letters.

NO USER INTERFACE ANYWHERE: no windows, menu bars, buttons, icons, toolbars, panels, form fields, cursors, floating rectangles or screenshot-like elements. Screens carry only soft glow or vague painterly shapes.
